# Tubi
> Free ad-supported streaming service for watching movies, TV shows, live channels, and Tubi Originals online.

Tubi offers on-demand entertainment across major genres and categories, with no subscription required. The site organizes content by movies, TV shows, live TV, featured collections, and genre hubs, and supports browsing individual titles, series, and curated categories.

## Core Streaming
- [Home](https://tubitv.com/): Main entry point for free movies, TV shows, and featured programming.
- [Movies](https://tubitv.com/movies): Browse Tubi’s free movie catalog across genres and curated collections.
- [TV Shows](https://tubitv.com/tv-shows): Explore free television series, episodic content, and bingeable shows.
- [Live TV](https://tubitv.com/live): Watch free live channels covering news, entertainment, sports, and more.

## Featured & Discovery
- [Featured](https://tubitv.com/category/featured): Editorially highlighted movies and shows promoted on the platform.
- [Most Popular](https://tubitv.com/category/most_popular): Trending and frequently watched titles across Tubi’s catalog.
- [Recently Added](https://tubitv.com/category/recently_added): Newly added movies and shows available for streaming.
- [Recommended](https://tubitv.com/category/recommended_for_you): Personalized recommendations based on viewing activity and preferences.
- [Tubi Originals](https://tubitv.com/category/tubi_originals): Original films and series produced or distributed under the Tubi brand.
- [Creatorverse](https://tubitv.com/category/creators): Collection focused on creator-led and digital-native entertainment.
- [Black Storytelling](https://tubitv.com/category/black_cinema): Curated hub for Black cinema, stories, and creators.

## Movie & TV Genres
- [Action](https://tubitv.com/category/action): Action films and series featuring adventure, combat, and thrill-driven plots.
- [Comedy](https://tubitv.com/category/comedy): Comedies ranging from stand-up and sitcoms to feature films.
- [Drama](https://tubitv.com/category/drama): Dramatic stories, character-driven films, and serialized television.
- [Horror](https://tubitv.com/category/horror): Horror movies and shows including supernatural, slasher, and suspense titles.
- [Anime](https://tubitv.com/category/anime): Anime series and films spanning action, fantasy, and classic favorites.
- [Adult Animation](https://tubitv.com/category/adult_animation): Animated series and films aimed at mature audiences.
- [Documentaries](https://tubitv.com/category/documentary): Nonfiction films covering culture, history, crime, and real-world topics.
- [Docuseries](https://tubitv.com/category/docuseries): Serialized documentary programming and episodic nonfiction storytelling.

## TV, Family & Specialty Categories
- [Crime TV](https://tubitv.com/category/crime_tv): Crime-focused television including procedurals, investigations, and thrillers.
- [Classic TV & Movies](https://tubitv.com/category/classics): Older films and television series from earlier eras of entertainment.
- [Family Movies](https://tubitv.com/category/family_movies): Family-friendly films suitable for group and all-ages viewing.
- [Films et séries français](https://tubitv.com/category/french_movies_and_series): French-language movies and series available on the platform.

## Content Types
- [Movie Pages](https://tubitv.com/movies): Entry point for individual movie detail and playback pages.
- [Series Pages](https://tubitv.com/series): Entry point for series detail pages and episode browsing.
- [Category Pages](https://tubitv.com/category/featured): Collection pages grouping titles by theme, genre, or editorial curation.
- [Live Channel Pages](https://tubitv.com/live): Live streaming channel directory and playback experience.

## Platform Use Cases
- [Free Streaming Without Subscription](https://tubitv.com/): Watch ad-supported content without a paid membership.
- [Browse by Genre](https://tubitv.com/category/action): Discover titles through genre-specific category hubs.
- [Watch Trending Titles](https://tubitv.com/category/most_popular): Find popular content currently resonating with viewers.
- [Find New Additions](https://tubitv.com/category/recently_added): Keep up with the latest catalog additions.
- [Explore Original Programming](https://tubitv.com/category/tubi_originals): Access Tubi-branded exclusive and original content.

## Notable Site Areas
- [Recommended for You](https://tubitv.com/category/recommended_for_you): Personalized discovery section for returning viewers.
- [Featured Collections](https://tubitv.com/category/featured): Rotating promotional shelves and curated content groupings.
- [Creator-Led Content](https://tubitv.com/category/creators): Programming centered on internet and creator ecosystem talent.
- [Black Cinema Collection](https://tubitv.com/category/black_cinema): Dedicated collection highlighting Black stories and filmmakers.

## Audience & Viewing Options
- [Family Viewing](https://tubitv.com/category/family_movies): Family-oriented movies for shared viewing sessions.
- [Anime Fans](https://tubitv.com/category/anime): Destination for anime viewers seeking series and films.
- [Documentary Viewers](https://tubitv.com/category/documentary): Nonfiction catalog for educational and factual programming.
- [Crime Enthusiasts](https://tubitv.com/category/crime_tv): Crime television hub for mystery and investigation fans.
- [French-Language Viewers](https://tubitv.com/category/french_movies_and_series): French-language programming collection for bilingual and francophone audiences.
